extDescription.message: Edit audio and video on any website in real time: speed, A/V sync, equalizer, volume boost, picture filters and more.

cmdLoop.message: A-B loop: set A → set B → off

cmdScreenshot.message: Save a screenshot of the video

sliderModeHint.message: The thumb's rings set the step size: grabbed inside ±1 (fine), middle ±5, outside ±10. Drag: pulled along the track the thumb moves in those steps, pulled up/down and circled it turns (clockwise for more). Turn: a press always turns.

sliderHintDrag.message: Grabbed inside ±1, middle ±5, outside ±10 · pull sideways: move in those steps · pull up/down and circle: turn · Double-click: reset · Mouse wheel: change (Shift: 10 steps)

sliderHintTurn.message: Turn the thumb like a knob: grabbed inside ±1, middle ±5, outside ±10 – clockwise for more · Click on the track: jump there · Double-click: reset · Mouse wheel: change (Shift: 10 steps)

mediaFoundOne.message: 1 media element found – changes apply instantly.

mediaFoundMany.message: $1 media elements found – changes apply instantly.

ready.message: Ready – changes apply to all video/audio in this tab (including embedded players).

notAvailable.message: Not available on this page (e.g. about: pages or addons.mozilla.org).

statusAudioBlocked.message: Audio effects blocked – an older Klangbild version still holds this page's sound (after an update). Reloading frees it.

statusDrmSilent.message: A copy-protected video was routed through Web Audio and is now silent – please reload the page.

statusDrm.message: Copy-protected video (DRM): audio effects don't work here – speed and video filters do.

audioDelayHint.message: Positive: sound is early → the sound is delayed. Negative: sound is late (e.g. Bluetooth) → the picture is delayed.

toolsDrmNote.message: Copy-protected video (DRM): screenshot, analyzer, audio effects and picture delay aren't possible here. Speed, video filters, loop and frame stepping work.

noMediaPlaying.message: No video/audio found – is anything playing yet?

drmAnalyzeHint.message: The page's audio isn't available – analyze what your speakers play instead.

webAudioHint.message: Routes the sound through Web Audio – media from other servers may go silent.

analyzerIntro.message: Analyzes everything your computer plays – any tab or app, including copy-protected streams. Nothing is recorded or saved.

permissionDenied.message: Permission was denied or the dialog was closed.

sourceNoAudio.message: The shared source has no audio.

shareDialogHint.message: In the dialog choose "Entire screen" and tick "Also share system audio".

loopbackHint.message: Needs a device that returns your speaker output, e.g. "Stereo Mix" (Sound settings → Recording → show disabled devices) or the free virtual cable VB-CABLE. Device names appear after the first start.

screenshotNotAllowed.message: Screenshot not allowed here (copy protection or foreign source)

noMediaData.message: No media data yet – start playback first

stereoWidthHint.message: 0 %: mono, 100 %: original, 200 %: extra wide. Above 100 % the limiter is always on.

offsetHint.message: Moves the picture, e.g. to show another part of a zoomed video.

defaultActive.message: Sites without their own settings start with your default.

defaultNone.message: No default set – sites without their own settings start neutral.

noSites.message: No site settings saved yet. Tick "Remember for …" in the panel to add one.

backupHint.message: Saves remembered sites, disabled sites, custom presets and the default to a JSON file. Importing merges a file into the current data.

importFailed.message: This file isn't a Klangbild backup.

colorVisionHint.message: Correction for color blindness: colors that look alike are shifted to ones that can still be told apart.

disableHereHint.message: Klangbild then leaves video and audio on this site completely alone. The page is reloaded.

disabledHere.message: Klangbild is disabled on this site.

sleepInactive.message: Pauses playback after the chosen time, fading out over the last 10 seconds.

disabledSitesHint.message: Klangbild doesn't touch video and audio on these sites. Removing one takes effect when the site is reloaded.

extendedLimitsHint.message: The sidebar's sliders reach further than the popup's, e.g. speed $1×, volume up to $2 %, equalizer ±$3 dB and audio delay up to $4 ms. Firefox mutes the sound outside 0.25×–4×.

sliderStepsHint.message: How far − / + and the arrow keys move a slider. Leave empty for the default.

dialogHint.message: Positive: music, effects and room quieter – speech mixed to the center stays. Negative: voices quieter. Works best with stereo; with mono only the frequency range separates. Delays the sound by about 21 ms.

mixerHint.message: Every video and audio in every tab. Volume and mute come on top of the tab's settings and last until the page is reloaded.

mixerEmpty.message: Nothing is playing. As soon as a tab plays sound, it shows up here.

mixerDrm.message: Copy-protected – only the whole tab can be muted.

mixerNoAccess.message: No access to this page – only the whole tab can be muted.

mixerDisabledHere.message: Klangbild is disabled on this site – only the whole tab can be muted.

mixerNative.message: From another server: controlled through the player's own volume, so at most 100 %.

reloadResumeHint.message: Reloads the page and continues playback at the same position.

skipSilenceHint.message: Plays quiet passages three times as fast – handy for talks and podcasts. What counts as silence follows the loudness of the recording.

ambilightHint.message: A colored glow around the picture in the colors of its edges. Looks best on dark pages and in fullscreen with black bars.

rulesHint.message: Settings applied automatically to certain addresses: a preset and/or a speed. Patterns: "example.com" (with subdomains), "example.com/podcasts/*" or "example.com/watch?v=*". * stands for any text; the most specific matching rule wins. Also works when a page changes its address without reloading.

ruleBadPattern.message: This pattern can't match any address. Example: example.com/podcasts/*

ruleNeedsAction.message: Choose a preset or enter a speed.

ruleAdded.message: Rule saved – it applies from the next page load.

continueWatchingHint.message: Videos and audio of 2 minutes or longer continue where you left off – on any website. Positions stay in your browser, stored under a hash of the address (no readable history), and never from private windows.
